page_title: MON 1-0 CAG | Monza v Cagliari 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Monza.

90+3' The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick. Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) gets inside the box and tries to beat Simone Scuffet with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90+2' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Armando Izzo (Monza) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
89' Looks like Armando Izzo (Monza) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
88' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Deiola will be replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
87' Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul after Alessio Zerbin (Monza) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
85' That was close. Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
84' Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eldor Shomurodov.
84' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Tommaso Augello is replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
82' Here's the change. Milan Djuric leaves the pitch and Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) comes on as a substitute.
81' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari). Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:7.
76' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Here is a change. Samuele Birindelli is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Luca Caldirola (Monza).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Valentin Carboni (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Colpani.
73' Andrea Carboni (Monza) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
71' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Andrea Colpani (Monza) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Monza get a corner.
68' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
68' The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Cagliari have a corner.
65' Warren Bondo (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
65' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Cagliari take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
63' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Dany Mota and he is replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Daniel Maldini walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Monza).
62' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' A cross into the box from Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
61' It looks like Andrea Carboni (Monza) saw red with that tackle. Matteo Marcenaro won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Monza.
52' Andrea Colpani (Monza) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
51' Dany Mota (Monza) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box.
48' Andrea Colpani (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Gaetano Oristanio comes on in place of Jakub Jankto (Cagliari).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) is replaced by Matteo Prati.
46' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Dany Mota (Monza). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

41' 1 - 0 Daniel Maldini (Monza) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball towards the top left corner, bouncing in off the post.
39' Flag up against Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
37' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
35' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Daniel Maldini (Monza) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
34' Dany Mota (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
30' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Armando Izzo (Monza) for his blatant foul.
26' 65:35 – the latest ball possession ratio.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.

23' Dany Mota (Monza) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

21' Daniel Maldini (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marcenaro with no other option than to blow for a foul.
17' The Monza players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Dany Mota (Monza) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
8' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post.
6' Matteo Pessina (Monza) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
5' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

5' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
2' What a big chance! Dany Mota (Monza) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
Cagliari will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marcenaro.
